verdict.rationale: Gram is a SaaS control plane with its own platform API surface (CLI, platform MCP server), so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair things to ask about. The pack contains no evidence of a versioned public API or any documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. 'Versioned' SKILL.md manifests and deployment history with redeploys are about customer content and deployments, not platform API versioning.
